title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
summary: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by constructing inference-time workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, and code execution. While such workflows enable flexible problem solving, the useful procedures discovered during execution are often transient: they help solve the current task but are not retained in a form that can systematically benefit future tasks. We present FlowEvo, a training-free framework that compiles successful traces into reusable skill records. Each record pairs a callable artifact with auxiliary structured guidance, and admission applies interface, replay, and safety checks where feasible. These skill records persist in a skill bank at inference time. FlowEvo is organized around three coupled mechanisms: (1)~workflow-to-skill compilation, which extracts reusable executable artifacts from successful traces; (2)~skill-to-workflow feedback, which retrieves accumulated skills to support future problem solving through either direct execution or structured context injection; and (3)~skill curation, which monitors downstream utility and suppresses skills that cause negative transfer. Through this workflow--skill--workflow feedback loop, FlowEvo enables agents to accumulate and refine task-solving capability over time without updating model parameters. Experiments on benchmarks spanning interactive environments (ALFWorld) and code/math generation (HumanEval, GSM8K) show that FlowEvo achieves the best accuracy-cost tradeoff among the evaluated baselines under our implementation settings. On ALFWorld, FlowEvo achieves an 82.8\% success rate, 23.6 percentage points above the strongest baseline, while its average token usage per episode is less than half that of the most efficient baseline. Controlled ablations confirm that each mechanism contributes to the overall result. The code is public at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/FlowEvo.

title: Risk Is Not the Target: A Monotonic Framework for Evaluating Wildfire Operational Risk Signals
comments: Accepted in 2026 IEEE 50th Annual Computers, Software, and Applications Conference (COMPSAC)
summary: Evaluating wildfire risk systems using standard machine-learning metrics such as F1-score or IoU is fundamentally flawed: these metrics assess event prediction accuracy, not the operational coherence of a continuous risk signal. This work proposes a novel monotonic evaluation framework that measures whether increases in a predicted risk score consistently correspond to increases in observed operational load, such as number of fires, intervention time, and deployed resources. Moreover, we compare three structurally different approaches on the French Alpes-Maritimes department: the expert-based DFE index, GRU- based predictive models, and FARS, a hybrid multi-agent system combining predictive AI with LLM-based reasoning. Experimental results reveal that the DFE, despite poor classification metrics, exhibits the most balanced monotonic behavior across the full risk scale. GRU models achieve strong local monotonicity but fail to produce well-distributed risk levels. FARS inherits and reveals the structural limitations of upstream signals rather than correcting them. The central finding is a paradigm shift: a good risk model does not predict fires accurately, but one whose ordinal scale meaningfully explains operational dynamics, as proved in this paper. Code of the monotonic framework is available on github.

title: Control panels to clarify user intent with Large Language Models
summary: Typical user interfaces for Large Language Models present a blank prompt window that invites a natural language query by users, but offers little guidance. This paper proposes a visual control panel interface that would provide more cues to the semantics of prompt formation, enabling users to more easily express their intent. By emphasizing recognition over recall, control panels help users formulate more effective prompts that match their intent.

title: Decoupled Attention Fusion: Accelerating RAG with Efficient KV Cache Reuse
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively mitigates hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) but suffers from prohibitive Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) latency in long-context scenarios. Reusing pre-computed document KV caches addresses this but introduces a distribution mismatch, where offline caches lack the inter-document attention patterns required for coherent reasoning. CacheBlend reduces recomputation via selective attention, but suffers severe accuracy degradation at longer contexts. To address these challenges, we propose Decoupled Attention Fusion (DAF), a framework that maintains high accuracy while significantly reducing recomputation overhead. DAF decouples the attention process into three integrated stages: important-token self-attention to restore missing inter-document attention, question-document self-attention for standard inference, and a state fusion that concatenates their outputs to synthesize the final hidden states. By decoupling these operations into dense patterns, DAF is natively compatible with Flash-Attention kernels, maximizing hardware utilization without requiring complex attention masks. Experiments show that DAF delivers up to 2 times speedup over CacheBlend and 5.6 times over full recomputation with vLLM on long-context benchmarks, without sacrificing accuracy.

title: Securing Multimodal AI through Internal Information Decomposition
comments: Accepted as Spotlight Paper at ICML 2026
summary: Multimodal large language models introduce attack surfaces absent in unimodal systems: adversaries can distribute malicious intent across modalities to evade unimodal safeguards. This motivates using cross-modal consistency as a detection signal rather than inspecting each modality in isolation. Our key observation is that benign inputs induce compatible predictive behavior from text-only and vision-only reasoning that stabilizes when fused, whereas adversarial manipulation disrupts this consistency, causing abnormal multimodal behavior. Existing defenses that examine raw inputs or outputs overlook this internal fusion process, rendering them brittle and computationally expensive. We propose FlowGuard, a lightweight inference-time framework that detects harmful inputs by monitoring internal multimodal consistency. Unlike approaches that rely on scalar confidence metrics, FlowGuard derives FlowVectors inspired by Partial Information Decomposition that quantify cross-modal redundancy, synergy, and modality-specific dominance, capturing whether fused multimodal predictions remain aligned with unimodal semantic evidence. In a one-class classification problem trained solely on benign data, FlowGuard reduces Attack Success Rates from >90% to <15% on unseen attacks, with <3% utility loss and up to a 6 times latency reduction. Our results demonstrate that monitoring cross-modal consistency offers an efficient and effective defense for multimodal reasoning.

title: From Frame-Level Recognition to Event-Level Confirmation: Repair Traces and Runtime Failure Analysis of Public-Space Gesture Interaction
summary:
Public-space gesture interaction is often evaluated as a frame-level recognition problem, but deployed systems expose a different failure boundary. In scenic kiosks, exhibition halls, and service terminals, users experience whether an intended action becomes a stable interaction event, not whether individual hand-landmark frames are correct. We call this the recognition-to-interaction gap.
  This paper analyzes 8 engineering repair records from a scenic-area interactive kiosk project, covering 4 gesture tasks: two-hand bowing, single-hand fist shaking, two-hand catching control, and knowledge-graph node hovering. From these traces, we extract 20 failure instances and organize them into six non-exclusive working failure classes: model-output degeneration, temporal mismatch, geometric-scale instability, coordinate-rendering mismatch, runtime lifecycle failure, and feedback synchronization and recovery failure.
  We further organize recurring repair mechanisms into an event-level runtime abstraction between the hand-landmark model and the interaction task. The contribution is deliberately bounded: a deployment-grounded failure taxonomy, an event-confirmation runtime abstraction, and case-study findings. We do not claim a new recognition model, large-scale user evaluation, or quantified accuracy gains.

title: Transferable Latency Prediction for Fast LLM Screening on Heterogeneous Edge Devices
summary:
Accurate latency prediction is critical for deploying large language models (LLMs) on heterogeneous edge devices, where inference latency is affected by model architecture, prompt behavior, runtime backend, hardware utilization, dynamic voltage and frequency scaling (DVFS), and thermal variation. This paper presents a runtime-aware latency prediction framework for deployment-oriented LLM selection. The framework represents each inference request as a hardware-runtime-model-prompt configuration, separates inference into prefill and decode phases, and adaptively fuses static descriptors with dynamic hardware telemetry through a gated prediction model.
  We evaluate the framework using Pixel mobile devices and validate the profiling pipeline on Jetson Nano, Orange Pi 5 Pro, and an RTX 3090-class GPU platform. On Pixel 8, the full predictor improves total-latency R-squared from 0.953 to 0.960 and decode-latency R-squared from 0.957 to 0.973 over a static-only baseline. On Pixel 8 Pro, it improves prefill-latency R-squared from -1.383 to 0.966. For cross-device transfer, calibration improves Pixel 8 Pro to Pixel 8 total-latency R-squared from -0.974 to 0.940 and decode-latency R-squared from -1.085 to 0.927. Heterogeneous profiling further shows that latency is highly device- and runtime-dependent: the same SmolLM2 model family reaches 8.42 tokens/s on Orange Pi 5 Pro but 64.38 tokens/s on an RTX 3090-class GPU. These results demonstrate that runtime-aware prediction with lightweight calibration can reduce profiling cost and support latency-aware LLM deployment across heterogeneous edge platforms.

title: Analyzing Middle School Students' Dialogue and Behaviors during Collaborative AI Chatbot Development Using Ordered Network Analysis
summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) education has become a key component of K-12 curricula, activities such as designing and developing conversational agents are increasingly used as instructional practice. Prior work has primarily examined these activities by focusing on students' learning outcomes or the quality of final AI artifacts, offering limited insight into the collaborative processes through which learning unfolds during AI system development. Although the AIED community has a long history of studying collaborative learning in STEM and Computing education, the emergence of AI learning environments in which students build AI systems presents new opportunities to understand how collaboration unfolds in AI education contexts. Grounded in these foundational works, the current study examines collaborative interaction among middle school students engaged in the design and development of an AI chatbot. Using Ordered Network Analysis of students' dialogue and development actions, we characterize how collaboration is organized over time and how interaction patterns relate to chatbot quality and AI knowledge outcomes. Results reveal that higher-quality chatbots are associated with more integrated sequences linking explanation, testing, and refinement. Interaction patterns involving articulated reasoning and repeated testing and revision in response to chatbot output were also associated with stronger AI knowledge outcomes. These findings provide a process-oriented account of collaborative AI chatbot development and extend AIED research on collaborative learning processes to AI education contexts.

title: AgentKVShift: Efficient KV Cache Reuse for Agentic Memory Systems
summary: Memory-augmented LLM agents maintain context across hundreds of interactions through agentic memory systems that actively curate retrieved content with LLM-generated metadata such as summaries, keywords, and tags. From an inference cost standpoint, every retrieval triggers a full re-encoding of these structured memory units into Key-Value (KV) states, which dominates prefill latency. Existing training-free KV reuse methods mitigate this by selectively recomputing a small fraction of tokens, but were designed for RAG-style raw passages and degrade on structured agentic memories. We present AgentKVShift, a training-free, probe-guided KV residual correction method that operates per retrieved memory unit. One of the crucial insights we demonstrate is that the per-memory KV reuse residual decomposes into a shared memory-level offset plus small token-wise fluctuations. Estimating this offset from a small probe set allows us to correct every reused token by a single weighted correction. Unlike prior reuse methods which decide which tokens to recompute and leave the rest of the cache stale, AgentKVShift also corrects the tokens it does not recompute, turning the refresh budget into useful signal across the entire chunk. Across four open-source LLMs spanning 3B to 32B parameters and two long-horizon agentic memory benchmarks (long-term dialogue and agentic applications), AgentKVShift achieves near full recompute performance while refreshing only 10-30% of the cache, outperforming baselines at the same recompute ratio. It requires up to 5x lower recompute to reach this near-full performance, which prior reuse methods only attain at 45-55% refresh. In this regime, AgentKVShift delivers prefill speedups of 2-3.5x over no-KV-reuse on a single A100. AgentKVShift orthogonally composes with KV cache quantization, retaining over 2x the F1 of prior reuse methods under aggressive 2- and 4-bit settings.

title: Natural Language Processing in Health Professions Education: A Scoping Review
comments: This manuscript has been accepted at the 14th IEEE International Conference on Healthcare Informatics (ICHI 2026)
summary: Natural language processing (NLP) and artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly transforming health professions education, yet no scoping review has systematically mapped their applications across the full spectrum of health education contexts, including public health. Following the Arksey and O'Malley framework and PRISMA-ScR guidelines, this review synthesized evidence from 64 studies published between 2015 and 2026, identified through searches of PubMed, ERIC, IEEE Xplore, and Google Scholar. Seven thematic domains were identified: automated assessment, large language models (LLMs) as student-facing learning support, virtual patients and clinical simulation, curriculum analysis and program evaluation, personalized and adaptive learning, public health and health promotion education, and educator and institutional integration. Findings reveal significant technical promise, particularly in automated assessment, clinical simulation, and curriculum analysis, alongside persistent challenges including hallucination and accuracy concerns, algorithmic bias, data privacy, digital divide, overreliance, and absence of standardized outcome measures. Only four studies explicitly addressed public health education, representing a major evidence gap. This review provides a foundation for evidence-informed integration of NLP and AI across health professions education and highlights public health education as a priority area for future research and investment.

title: TILT: Improving Compositional Generation in Diffusion Models with a Model-Intrinsic Reward
summary: Recent advances in powerful text-to-image generation models have made it increasingly important to develop test-time methods that modify the sampling trajectory to produce images more faithful to complex compositional prompts. We present TILT, a training-free framework for compositional text-to-image generation via test-time reward alignment. We interpret compositional failures as overlap modes between joint and single-concept distributions, and define a reward that favors samples where all concepts are jointly present. This reward is intrinsic to the base model and does not require any external supervision or reward models. This yields a KL-constrained objective with a closed-form tilted target distribution and principled guiding steps for diffusion sampling. The interaction of concept distributions together with the above reward naturally leads to two different guidance strategies while a hybrid approach that balances their respective benefits produces stronger performance. Experiments on prompts from T2ICompBench show that our method improves compositional alignment while preserving image quality compared to previous baselines.

title: Spectral Flow Certificates for Depth-Aware Long-Range Propagation in Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph Neural Networks propagate information through local message passing, but the graph topologies themselves can silently prevent any amount of training from solving long-range tasks. When we deploy GNNs on new graphs, there is currently no inexpensive way to know, before training begins, whether the graphs' structures will allow information to travel far enough between distant nodes. We address this gap by proposing Spectral Flow Certificates (SFCs), single scalars computed from the graphs' normalised Laplacians in seconds, requiring no model training and no labelled data. An SFC fuses a graph's algebraic connectivity with the chosen message-passing depth into one number that measures how much of the critical spectral bottleneck can be traversed within the available depth budget. Unlike raw spectral gaps, which are static and depth-agnostic, SFCs adapt as the number of layers increases and therefore carry strictly more diagnostic information when depths vary. Compared with classical structural statistics such as average effective resistance and graph diameter, SFCs explain more than twice as much variance in trained GNN long-range accuracy. Across twenty-five synthetic graph families spanning paths, cycles, grids, regular graphs, and random graphs, SFCs predict trained accuracy before any gradients are computed, achieving explanatory power above ninety percent at all tested depths. The same predictive relationships hold on one hundred fifty real molecular graph topologies drawn from three independent benchmark datasets, confirming that the findings are not artefacts of their synthetic construction. Taken together, these results show that a single eigenvalue computation is sufficient to flag topology-limited graphs before committing to expensive training pipelines, providing a principled first filter for GNN deployments.

title: From Obligation to Specification: A Survey on Validating EU AI Act Requirements in RE
summary: With the EU AI Act entering into force, organizations developing or operating AI systems face new obligations on transparency, risk management, and traceability. For Requirements Engineering (RE), these obligations must be translated into testable, auditable requirements and verifiable evidence. However, many organizations currently lack systematic processes to achieve this. We hypothesize that LLM-based agentic validation tools can support this translation, thereby helping to close this gap. We present a mixed-method exploratory study with expert interviews (N=10) and an online survey (N=15) to assess organizational preparedness for EU AI Act-oriented RE and perceptions of LLM-based, agentic closed-loop validation tools, with participants spanning RE, data science, development, and compliance roles. Our results show that, although the EU AI Act is viewed as highly relevant, structured mechanisms to capture regulatory obligations, propagate updates into projects, and maintain lifecycle-wide traceability and evidence are often missing. Participants see LLM-based tools as promising for mapping obligations to requirements, assessing coverage, and organizing evidence, but express strong concerns about full automation and stress the need for safeguards. Based on these findings, we outline minimum requirements for an EU AI Act-ready closed-loop approach.

AI.title_translation: 从义务到规范：需求工程中验证欧盟人工智能法案要求的综述与研究
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了如何利用基于大模型（LLM）的智能体工具，将《欧盟人工智能法案》的合规义务转化为需求工程中的可验证要求，并指出了当前组织的准备现状与工具应用前景。
AI.motivation: 随着《欧盟人工智能法案》的生效，组织在透明度、风险管理和可追溯性上面临新的法律义务，但需求工程（RE）领域缺乏将这些义务转化为可测试、可审计要求和可验证证据的系统化流程。作者假设基于LLM的智能体验证工具可以弥补这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法（Mixed-method exploratory study），包括10位专家的访谈（N=10）和15份在线问卷调查（N=15），以评估组织对欧盟人工智能法案导向的需求工程的准备情况及对LLM智能体闭环验证工具的看法。
AI.result: 结果表明，尽管各方高度重视欧盟人工智能法案，但普遍缺乏捕捉监管义务、传播项目更新以及维护生命周期可追溯性和证据的结构化机制；参与者认为LLM工具在映射义务、评估覆盖率和组织证据方面很有前景，但对完全自动化表示强烈担忧并强调需要安全保障。
AI.conclusion: 组织在应对欧盟人工智能法案（EU AI Act）时普遍缺乏系统化和结构化的机制，而基于LLM的智能体验证工具在辅助合规方面展现出巨大潜力，但仍需加强安全防护并避免完全自动化。
AI.translation: 随着《欧盟人工智能法案》的生效，开发或运营AI系统的组织在透明度、风险管理和可追溯性方面面临新的义务。对于需求工程（RE）而言，这些义务必须转化为可测试、可审计的要求和可验证的证据。然而，许多组织目前缺乏实现这一目标的系统化流程。我们假设基于LLM的智能体验证工具可以支持这种转化，从而帮助缩小这一差距。我们提出了一项混合方法探索性研究，包括专家访谈（N=10）和在线调查（N=15），以评估组织对面向EU AI Act的需求工程的准备情况以及对基于LLM的智能体闭环验证工具的看法，参与者涵盖RE、数据科学、开发和合规等角色。我们的研究结果表明，尽管EU AI Act被认为高度相关，但通常缺乏捕获监管义务、将更新传播到项目中以及维护全生命周期可追溯性和证据的结构化机制。参与者认为基于LLM的工具在将义务映射到需求、评估覆盖率和组织证据方面很有前景，但对完全自动化表示强烈担忧，并强调需要安全保障。基于这些发现，我们概述了构建符合EU AI Act要求的闭环方法的最低要求。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了组织在满足《欧盟人工智能法案》合规要求方面面临的挑战，通过专家访谈和问卷调查评估了组织准备情况及对基于LLM的智能体验证工具的看法，并提出了构建欧盟AI法案合规就绪闭环方法的最低要求。

title: Coupled Hierarchical Search over Topology and Execution for Agentic Workflow Synthesis
summary: Although structured workflows empower Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex problems, automating their creation is severely hindered by a vast combinatorial search space, frequently resulting in inflexible and resource-heavy offline training dependencies. To address this, we conceptualize workflow generation as an intertwined topology-and-execution search paradigm, where the broader topological layer dictates subtask boundaries and lower-level execution outcomes actively reshape the topology itself. Building on this foundation, we introduce HierFlow, a training-free, test-time hierarchical search architecture that automates agentic workflow design by merging feedback-guided topology adjustments with a fast, MCTS-inspired tree search for sub-workflow optimization. HierFlow maximizes efficiency through an intelligent gating module that selectively triggers execution-level searches based on contextual necessity, a mechanism we further support with an in-depth analysis detailing how varying degrees of cross-task coupling impact the effectiveness of hierarchical splitting. Comprehensive testing across question answering, mathematical reasoning, and code generation benchmarks confirms that HierFlow consistently outperforms strong baselines, delivering an optimal balance of high-quality results and computational efficiency without any additional training overhead.

AI.title_translation: 拓扑与执行耦合的分层搜索用于智能体工作流合成
AI.tldr: HierFlow提出了一种免训练的测试时分层搜索架构，通过将拓扑调整与基于MCTS的执行搜索相互耦合及门控触发，实现了高效的智能体工作流自动合成。
AI.motivation: 自动化创建智能体工作流面临极大的组合搜索空间挑战，现有方法常依赖资源消耗大且缺乏灵活性的离线训练过程。
AI.method: 提出了免训练的测试时分层搜索架构HierFlow。该架构将工作流生成视为拓扑与执行交织的范式：高层利用反馈引导调整工作流拓扑结构，低层借助受蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）启发的树搜索优化子工作流，并采用智能门控模块根据上下文按需触发执行层搜索。
AI.result: 在问答、数学推理和代码生成等多个基准测试中，HierFlow均显著超越强基线方法，在无需任何额外训练开销的情况下实现了高解答质量与计算效率的最优平衡。
AI.conclusion: HierFlow证明了将拓扑规划与低层执行有效耦合的分层搜索范式，能够摆脱昂贵离线训练的束缚，在测试阶段高效生成高质量的智能体工作流。
AI.translation: 尽管结构化工作流能够增强大型语言模型（LLMs）解决复杂问题的能力，但由于庞大的组合搜索空间，自动化创建工作流受到了极大阻碍，通常导致缺乏灵活性且依赖资源密集型的离线训练。为了解决这一问题，我们将工作流生成概念化为一个拓扑与执行交织的搜索范式，其中宏观拓扑层确定子任务边界，而低层执行结果则反过来积极重塑拓扑本身。基于这一理念，我们提出了HierFlow，这是一种免训练的测试时分层搜索架构，它通过结合反馈引导的拓扑调整与基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）启发的快速树搜索来优化子工作流，从而实现智能体工作流设计的自动化。HierFlow通过一个智能门控模块根据上下文需要选择性地触发执行级搜索，极大提高了效率；同时我们通过深度分析阐明了不同程度的跨任务耦合对分层拆分有效性的影响。在问答、数学推理和代码生成基准上的综合测试表明，HierFlow持续优于强基线方法，在没有任何额外训练开销的情况下，实现了高质量结果与计算效率的最佳平衡。
AI.summary: 本文针对大模型智能体工作流难以高效自动生成的难题，提出了免训练的分层搜索架构HierFlow。该方法通过耦合高层拓扑调整与低层基于MCTS的执行搜索，并辅以智能门控机制按需触发搜索，实现了高质量、高效率的自适应工作流合成。
AI.keywords: 智能体工作流, 分层搜索, 拓扑优化, 蒙特卡洛树搜索, 免训练
AI.comments: 创新性：将工作流合成抽象为拓扑与执行的双层动态耦合搜索，并利用门控机制自适应触发子搜索，设计巧妙且实用。重要性：实现了免训练（Training-free）的测试时自适应合成，有效解决了传统方法依赖庞大离线训练、缺乏灵活性的痛点。局限性：虽然引入了门控机制控制开销，但在极复杂任务下，测试阶段基于MCTS的反复推理搜索仍可能引入较高的时延与API调用费用。

title: SCOPE and SCION: A Benchmark and an Auditable Reference Pipeline for Schema Induction and Fusion from Text
summary: Schema graphs are an upstream bottleneck of schema-grounded information extraction and knowledge graph construction, yet most extraction systems assume the schema is already available. We introduce SCOPE (Schema Construction and Ontology-induction Pipeline Evaluation), a train-text-only benchmark for corpus-to-schema induction and optional schema fusion from raw text, built from 24 public information extraction sources (15 RE and 9 EE) normalized into evaluation-only gold schema graphs; its core event-extraction target covers event types and within-event argument roles, with inter-event links reported separately. We present SCION (Schema Construction and Induction with Ontology Normalization), an auditable reference pipeline rather than a new extraction architecture; it constructs candidate spaces from train text and restricts naming, merging, filtering, validation, and conservative fusion to candidate-linked evidence under strict JSON contracts. On the SCOPE core suite, SCION-lite attains the highest F1 among released source-schema references, Text2Onto-style, LLM-only, and matched extract-then-aggregate baselines under Literal, Fuzzy, Continuous, and Graph schema-graph metrics, while the compact open-model SCION-RL variant reduces reliance on proprietary LLM schema engineers. These results are reported against normalized typed-edge targets rather than as claims that induced schemas surpass human ontology design; the release includes evidence-linked outputs, parse/fallback logs, candidate retention/merging logs, run manifests, code, and benchmark packages at https://github.com/wandugu/paper_scion.

AI.title_translation: SCOPE与SCION：基于文本的模式归纳与融合基准及可审计参考流水线
AI.tldr: 本文推出了构建自纯文本的模式归纳基准SCOPE和具有证据可审计性的参考流水线SCION，实现了无需预定义模式的自动化模式图生成与融合。
AI.motivation: 模式图（Schema Graphs）是基于模式的信息抽取和知识图谱构建的上游瓶颈，但现有抽取系统通常假设模式已预先定义好。因此需要从纯文本中自动归纳并融合模式图。
AI.method:
1. **SCOPE基准**：汇集24个公共IE数据源（15个关系抽取，9个事件抽取），标准化为仅评估用的金标准模式图。
2. **SCION流水线**：一个可审计的参考架构，通过构建训练文本的候选空间，并在严格JSON契约下将命名、合并、过滤、验证与融合限制在与候选关联的证据上，生成模式图。
AI.result: 在SCOPE核心测试集上，SCION-lite在Literal、Fuzzy、Continuous和Graph等多个模式图评价指标下取得了最高的F1分数，优于现有多种基线；紧凑型开源变体SCION-RL减少了对专有大语言模型的依赖。
AI.conclusion: SCION证明了在严格的可审计证据约束下，从文本自动归纳与融合模式图的可行性与优越性。SCOPE基准与代码的开源将极大推动知识图谱和信息抽取领域上游Schema自动构建的研究。
AI.translation: 模式图（Schema graphs）是基于模式的信息抽取和知识图谱构建的上游瓶颈，然而大多数抽取系统都假设模式已经是预先可用的。本文介绍了SCOPE（模式构建与本体归纳流水线评估），这是一个仅基于训练文本的语料库到模式归纳及可选模式融合基准，由24个公共信息抽取源（15个关系抽取和9个事件抽取）构建并规范化为仅用于评估的标准模式图；其核心事件抽取目标涵盖事件类型和事件内论元角色，事件间链接则单独报告。本文还提出了SCION（具有本体规范化的模式构建与归纳），这是一个可审计的参考流水线而非新的抽取架构；它从训练文本构建候选空间，并在严格的JSON契约下将命名、合并、过滤、验证和保守融合限制在与候选关联的证据上。在SCOPE核心套件上，SCION-lite在Literal、Fuzzy、Continuous和Graph模式图指标下取得了已发布源模式参考、Text2Onto风格、仅LLM以及匹配的“抽取后聚合”基线中的最高F1值，而紧凑的开源模型SCION-RL变体减少了对专有LLM模式工程师的依赖。这些结果是针对规范化的带类型边目标报告的，而非声称归纳出的模式超越了人类的本体设计；本次发布包含证据链接的输出、解析/回退日志、候选保留/合并日志、运行清单、代码和基准包，网址为 https://github.com/wandugu/paper_scion。
AI.summary: 针对信息抽取中预定义模式获取困难的问题，本文提出了纯文本模式归纳基准SCOPE和可审计参考流水线SCION。SCOPE整合了24个IE数据源用于标准评估。SCION通过候选证据约束和JSON契约实现了可审计的模式归纳与融合。实验表明，SCION在多种指标下表现优异，且开源模型变体有效降低了对专有LLM的依赖。
AI.keywords: 模式归纳, 模式融合, 信息抽取, SCOPE基准, 模式图
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：提出了针对无模式（Schema-free）场景的SCOPE基准，将24个经典信息抽取数据集规范化为模式图评估目标，并构建了基于证据约束和严格JSON契约的可审计参考流水线SCION。
2. **重要性**：打破了大多数信息抽取和知识图谱构建依赖预定义Schema的假设，为从纯文本中自动化建立规范化Schema提供了统一评估标准和有效基线。
3. **局限性**：论文明确指出归纳出的模式主要针对带类型的图边，并非声称超越人类专家精心设计的本体；对于极其复杂的深层层次本体结构的归纳能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: A Systematic Survey on Image Description Techniques for STEM Domains
comments: This is the Author's Original Manuscript of an article accepted for publication in International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction, published by Taylor and Francis. The Version of Record is available at DOI 10.1080/10447318.2026.2668031
summary: The proliferation of visual data in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) fields presents accessibility barrier for individuals with blindness or visual impairments. While recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) offer new opportunities to generate textual descriptions of STEM images, the research landscape is fragmented and its impact on real users remains limited. This systematic survey examines 20 peer-reviewed studies on AI-based techniques for describing STEM visuals, with a specific focus on accessibility and human-computer interaction. Following the PRISMA methodology and a ROBIS-based risk-of-bias assessment, the review analyzes (i) the types of STEM visuals targeted, (ii) the AI and machine learning architectures employed, (iii) the datasets and evaluation metrics adopted, and (iv) the interaction modalities through which descriptions are delivered. The analysis reveals a shift from static, one-shot alt text toward interactive and multimodal systems that integrate conversational interfaces, keyboard navigation, and audio or haptic feedback. However, critical challenges persist, including factual inaccuracies and hallucinations, the scarcity of accessibility-first datasets co-designed with blind and low-vision users, and a heavy reliance on automatic text-overlap metrics that poorly capture perceived usefulness and trust. The survey concludes by outlining key research directions for HCI, emphasizing user-controlled verbosity, explainable and verifiable AI pipelines, and the integration of accessible description tools into mainstream STEM authoring and learning environments.
comment: This is the Author's Original Manuscript of an article accepted for publication in International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction, published by Taylor and Francis. The Version of Record is available at DOI 10.1080/10447318.2026.2668031

AI.title_translation: STEM领域图像描述技术系统综述
AI.tldr: 本系统综述探讨了STEM领域中基于AI的图像描述技术，旨在解决视障人士的无障碍问题，并分析了当前的研究格局、技术演变、存在挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: STEM领域视觉数据的激增给盲人或视力障碍者带来了无障碍障碍。尽管人工智能在生成STEM图像文本描述方面取得了进展，但研究分散且对实际用户的影响有限，因此需要进行系统性审查。
AI.method: 本研究对20项关于AI辅助STEM视觉描述技术的同行评审研究进行了系统综述，重点关注可访问性和人机交互。遵循PRISMA方法和基于ROBIS的偏倚风险评估，分析了目标视觉类型、AI架构、数据集、评估指标和交互模式。
AI.result: 分析显示，研究趋势从静态、一次性替代文本转向集成对话界面、键盘导航、音频或触觉反馈的交互式多模态系统。然而，挑战依然存在，包括事实不准确、幻觉、缺乏与盲人和低视力用户共同设计的数据集，以及过度依赖无法有效捕捉感知有用性和信任度的自动文本重叠指标。
AI.conclusion: 该综述总结了人机交互的关键研究方向，强调用户控制的详细程度、可解释和可验证的AI流程，以及将无障碍描述工具整合到主流STEM创作和学习环境中。
AI.translation: 科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）领域视觉数据的激增给盲人或视力障碍者带来了无障碍障碍。尽管人工智能（AI）的最新进展为生成STEM图像的文本描述提供了新机会，但研究领域分散，对实际用户的影响仍然有限。本系统综述考察了20项关于基于AI的STEM视觉描述技术的同行评审研究，特别关注可访问性和人机交互。遵循PRISMA方法和基于ROBIS的偏倚风险评估，本综述分析了（i）目标STEM视觉类型，（ii）采用的AI和机器学习架构，（iii）使用的数据集和评估指标，以及（iv）描述的交付交互模式。分析显示，研究从静态、一次性替代文本转向集成对话界面、键盘导航以及音频或触觉反馈的交互式多模态系统。然而，关键挑战依然存在，包括事实不准确和幻觉、缺乏与盲人和低视力用户共同设计的可访问性优先数据集，以及过度依赖未能很好捕捉感知有用性和信任度的自动文本重叠指标。本综述最后概述了人机交互的关键研究方向，强调用户控制的详细程度、可解释和可验证的AI流程，以及将无障碍描述工具整合到主流STEM创作和学习环境中。
AI.summary: 本系统综述旨在解决STEM领域中视障人士的图像无障碍问题。通过审查20项同行评审研究，该综述分析了AI驱动的STEM图像描述技术，重点关注可访问性和人机交互。研究发现，趋势正从静态替代文本转向交互式多模态系统，但仍面临事实不准确、数据集稀缺和评估指标不足等挑战。未来研究应侧重于用户控制、可解释AI和将工具整合到主流STEM环境中。
AI.keywords: STEM图像描述, 可访问性, 人工智能, 系统综述, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该论文通过对STEM领域图像描述技术的系统性审查，填补了该领域研究的空白，特别是关注了视障用户的可访问性需求。其创新之处在于识别了从静态描述到交互式多模态系统的转变，并明确指出了当前研究的局限性，如数据不足和评估指标的缺陷。对于推动人机交互和可解释AI在无障碍技术中的发展具有重要指导意义。

title: Procedural Knowledge Is Not Low-Rank: Why LoRA Fails to Internalize Multi-Step Procedures
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods like LoRA have become the default for adapting large language models, succeeding across instruction following, style transfer, and factual adaptation. We show that for procedural knowledge--the ability to follow multi-step procedures with conditional branching through to terminal states--LoRA fails to match full fine-tuning at the ranks where it retains its efficiency advantage. In a systematic ablation (r = 16--128) on a procedural travel booking task (14 nodes), all LoRA configurations fail uniformly (task success <= 2.54 vs. 4.11 for full fine-tuning, all p < 0.001), with scores decreasing at higher ranks--despite maintaining 95--99% conversation completion rates. Cross-domain replication on Zoom support (14 nodes) and insurance claims (55 nodes) at 8B confirms the failure generalizes: LoRA underperforms full fine-tuning by 0.8--2.2 points on average at both r = 32 and r = 128, with the largest gap on the most complex procedure. Quadrupling rank from 32 to 128 provides marginal improvement but does not close the gap. SVD analysis of the weight changes produced by full fine-tuning explains why: across three domains at both 3B and 8B, the mean effective rank of the update ranges from 761 to 1,026, and rank 128 captures only 43--51% of the squared Frobenius norm. Together, these findings establish that for procedural tasks LoRA falls well short of full fine-tuning--a fundamental limitation for agentic applications.

AI.title_translation: 过程性知识不是低秩的：为什么LoRA无法内化多步骤流程
AI.tldr: LoRA因其低秩假设而无法有效内化多步骤过程性知识（全量微调更新的有效秩高达761-1026），在Agent流程任务中显著落后于全量微调。
AI.motivation: 探究参数高效微调方法（如LoRA）在内化过程性知识（即遵循带有条件分支的多步骤流程直至终端状态的能力）时的实际效果及潜在局限性。
AI.method: 在旅行预订（14节点）、Zoom技术支持（14节点）和保险理赔（55节点）等多个领域的不同模型规模（3B、8B）上，系统性消融研究了不同Rank（r=16~128）下的LoRA与全量微调（Full Fine-Tuning）的表现；并通过奇异值分解（SVD）分析全量微调产生的权重更新矩阵的有效秩和Frobenius范数占比。
AI.result:
1. 在旅行预订任务中，所有LoRA配置均失败（任务成功率<=2.54 vs 全量微调4.11），且增加Rank未能改善性能。
2. 跨领域验证显示，LoRA在r=32和r=128时平均落后全量微调0.8-2.2分，流程越复杂差距越大。
3. SVD分析显示全量微调更新的平均有效秩高达761-1026，而Rank 128仅能捕获43-51%的平方Frobenius范数。
AI.conclusion: 过程性知识在权重空间中呈现高秩特征，LoRA等低秩微调方法无法有效内化复杂的多步骤流程，这对LLM在Agent等智能体应用中的部署构成了根本性局限。
AI.translation: 像LoRA这样的参数高效微调方法已成为适配大语言模型的默认选择，在指令遵循、风格迁移和事实适配方面取得了成功。我们表明，对于过程性知识——即通过条件分支遵循多步骤流程直至终态的能力——LoRA在保持其效率优势的秩（rank）范围内无法达到全量微调的效果。在针对过程性旅行预订任务（14个节点）的系统消融实验（r = 16–128）中，所有LoRA配置均出现一致性失效（任务成功率 <= 2.54，而全量微调为 4.11，所有 p < 0.001），且在更高秩下得分下降——尽管其保持了95–99%的对话完成率。在8B模型上对Zoom技术支持（14个节点）和保险理赔（55个节点）进行的跨领域复现证实了这种失效的普遍性：在 r = 32 和 r = 128 时，LoRA平均落后全量微调0.8–2.2分，且在最复杂的流程上差距最大。将秩从 32 翻倍增加到 128 仅带来微小的改进，未能缩小差距。对全量微调产生的权重变化进行SVD分析解释了原因：跨3个领域在3B和8B模型上，更新的平均有效秩范围为761到1026，而128的秩仅能捕获43–51%的平方Frobenius范数。这些发现共同表明，对于过程性任务，LoRA远未达到全量微调的效果——这是智能体应用面临的一个根本性局限。
AI.summary: 本研究探究了LoRA在适配过程性知识（多步骤流程与条件分支）时的局限性。实验表明，在多个领域的复杂流程任务中，LoRA的表现显著落后于全量微调，且仅增加Rank无法弥合差距。SVD分析进一步证实全量微调的更新矩阵具有极高的有效秩（761~1026），说明过程性知识本质上是高秩的，低秩近似无法有效捕获此类知识。
AI.keywords: LoRA, 过程性知识, 参数高效微调, 全量微调, 大语言模型
AI.comments:
创新性：该研究首次从权重更新矩阵的有效秩（Effective Rank）几何视角，揭示了过程性知识（Procedural Knowledge）的高秩属性，解释了低秩适应（LoRA）在复杂多步骤任务中失效的内在机制。
重要性：随着LLM向Agent（智能体）和自动化工作流（Workflow）演进，内化复杂的多步骤业务流程至关重要，该研究为AI Agent的微调方案选择提供了直接的实验支撑和理论指导。
局限性：论文仅对比了标准LoRA与全量微调，未探索如DoRA、QLoRA变体或混合微调策略是否能在保持效率的同时缓解高秩知识丢失的问题。

title: The Hard Decision Layer: Evidence for Committed Inference in Transformers
summary: We investigate where and how transformer-based language models commit to predictions in multiple-choice question answering. We identify the _Hard Decision Layer_ (HDL), a natural architectural property where answer option rankings stabilize abruptly during inference. Empirical validation across four language models (Qwen, Llama, Granite, Mistral) and four benchmark datasets demonstrates consistent HDL emergence without learned routing policies. We also show that the HDL is invariant to fine-tuning. Our results reveal striking accuracy improvements at the HDL: up to +0.61 (Qwen on CommonsenseQA), after which performance stabilizes. Systematic ablations on label formats and problem complexity confirm the phenomenon is fundamental to model architecture. These findings offer mechanistic insights into transformer inference and suggest opportunities for efficient reasoning and model steering. All code and results required to reproduce this work are available in https://github.com/Mystic-Slice/hard-decision-layer

AI.title_translation: 硬决策层：Transformer中承诺推理的证据
AI.tldr: 本文在Transformer语言模型中发现了一种名为“硬决策层”（HDL）的架构属性，在此层选项排名和预测准确率会突然稳定，为理解模型的推理机制提供了重要机制性见解。
AI.motivation: 探究基于Transformer的语言模型在多项选择问答中是在何时以及如何做出预测承诺的。
AI.method: 通过对四个语言模型（Qwen、Llama、Granite、Mistral）和四个基准数据集进行实证验证，并对标签格式和问题复杂度进行系统性消融实验。
AI.result: 在HDL处选项排名突然稳定，且准确率大幅提升（最高可达+0.61），此后性能保持稳定；HDL对微调具有不变性，且该现象是模型架构的基础属性。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型在推理过程中普遍存在“硬决策层”，在此层选项排名突变并稳定，该现象源于模型的基本架构，具有跨模型和跨数据集的普遍性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了基于Transformer的语言模型在多项选择问答中何时以及如何做出预测承诺。我们识别出了“硬决策层”（HDL），这是一种自然的架构属性，在此属性下，答案选项的排名在推理过程中会突然稳定。对四个语言模型（Qwen、Llama、Granite、Mistral）和四个基准数据集的实证验证表明，无需学习路由策略，HDL就会一致地出现。我们还表明，HDL对微调是不变的。我们的结果揭示了在HDL处显著的准确率提升：高达+0.61（Qwen在CommonsenseQA上），在此之后性能趋于稳定。对标签格式和问题复杂度的系统性消融证实了该现象是模型架构的基础。这些发现为Transformer推理提供了机制性见解，并暗示了进行高效推理和模型控制的机会。重现本工作所需的所有代码和结果可在 https://github.com/Mystic-Slice/hard-decision-layer 获取。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Transformer语言模型在多项选择问答中如何做出预测，发现了“硬决策层”（HDL）这一自然架构属性。在该层，选项排名急剧稳定且准确率显著提升。实证表明该现象跨模型和数据集一致存在，不受微调影响，为理解Transformer推理机制提供了新见解。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 语言模型, 硬决策层, 多项选择问答, 推理机制
AI.comments: 该论文通过揭示Transformer模型中存在“硬决策层”（HDL），深入探讨了语言模型在多选题推理中的预测承诺机制。这一发现无需复杂的学习路由策略，揭示了模型架构的内在规律，对提升推理效率和模型控制具有重要意义。

title: Household Movement Detection in Mixed-Format Occupancy Data Using LLM-Based Entity Resolution
comments: Computer Science & Information Technology (CS & IT) ISSN : 2231 - 5403, Volume 16, Number 10, May 2026
summary: Entity resolution (ER) typically relies on pairwise similarity comparisons between records, which limits its ability to capture indirect relationships present in demographic occupancy data. An important indirect pattern arises from household movement, where multiple individuals relocate together across addresses, but detecting such patterns is difficult due to mixed-format records, noise, duplication, and the absence of stable identifiers. This paper proposes an AI-enhanced framework for detecting indirect entity links associated with household movement in unstandardized name-address data. The approach integrates prompt-based large language model (LLM) named entity recognition for extracting personal names and addresses without extensive preprocessing, semantic text embeddings for robust similarity computation, and graph-based reasoning to infer group-level movement patterns. Experimental evaluation on SPX benchmark datasets (S8-S12) generated using the Synthetic Occupancy Generator demonstrates that incorporating indirect household movement evidence improves recall by 8-15% while maintaining high precision, yielding F1-score gains of 6-8% over a strong pairwise baseline.

AI.title_translation: 基于LLM实体解析的混合格式占用数据中家庭移动检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用大语言模型和图推理检测混合格式人口数据中家庭集体迁移的新型实体解析框架，显著提升了实体匹配的召回率和F1得分。
AI.motivation: 传统的实体解析主要依赖记录间的成对相似度比对，难以捕捉人口占用数据中如家庭集体迁移等复杂的间接关系，且面对混合格式、噪声、重复数据以及缺乏稳定标识符的情况时检测难度极大。
AI.method: 提出了一种AI增强的框架，整合了基于提示的大语言模型命名实体识别（用于提取姓名和地址）、语义文本嵌入（用于计算稳健的相似度）以及图推理（用于推断群体级迁移模式）。
AI.result: 在SPX基准数据集（S8-S12）上的实验表明，引入间接家庭迁移证据在保持高准确率的同时，将召回率提升了8-15%，F1分数比强大的成对基线提高了6-8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合LLM命名实体识别、语义文本嵌入与图推理，该框架能有效检测混合格式占用数据中的家庭集体迁移模式，显著提升实体解析的召回率和F1分数。
AI.translation: 实体解析（ER）通常依赖于记录之间的成对相似度比较，这限制了其捕获人口占用数据中存在的间接关系的能力。一个重要的间接模式源于家庭迁移，即多个人员跨地址共同重新安置，但由于记录格式混合、噪声、重复以及缺少稳定标识符，检测这种模式非常困难。本文提出了一种AI增强框架，用于检测非结构化姓名-地址数据中与家庭迁移相关的间接实体链接。该方法整合了基于提示的大语言模型（LLM）命名实体识别（用于在没有广泛预处理的情况下提取人名和地址）、用于鲁棒相似度计算的语义文本嵌入，以及用于推断群体级迁移模式的基于图的推理。在使用合成占用生成器生成的SPX基准数据集（S8-S12）上的实验评估表明，引入间接家庭迁移证据在保持高精确度的同时，将召回率提高了8-15%，与强大的成对基线相比，F1分数增益达到了6-8%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的实体解析框架，用于检测混合格式占用数据中的家庭迁移行为。该方法结合了LLM命名实体识别、语义嵌入和图推理，实验证明能有效提高实体链接的召回率和F1分数。
AI.keywords: 实体解析, 大语言模型, 图推理, 家庭迁移, 混合格式数据
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）与图推理相结合，解决了传统基于成对相似度比对的实体匹配方法在处理复杂、非结构化人口普查数据时无法捕捉家庭群体迁移等间接关系的难题，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: FrED: External Data Influence Estimation via Domain Knowledge Graph Grounding
summary: The rapid deployment of generative AI has amplified the critical need for Training Data Attribution to ensure transparency and accountability. However, current parametric approaches require computationally prohibitive access to model weights, while similarity-based methods ignore deep structural context. We propose a novel probabilistic framework that operates entirely in a black-box setting. Our method fuses continuous feature similarities with discrete, domain-specific Knowledge Graphs (KGs). This approach ensures the attribution is grounded in structural reality, explicitly rewarding highly specific historical samples while preventing generic background data from dominating the results. We evaluate our framework across two distinct domains where linking outputs to data and domain context is inherently complex: abstract artistic image synthesis and high-dimensional physical weather forecasting. Extensive benchmarking demonstrates the robust efficacy of our approach. In the artistic domain, it achieves a strong Linear Datamodeling Score that exceeds standard black-box similarity baselines, while closing much of the gap to gradient-based estimators. We additionally present a cross-domain feasibility case study in environmental forecasting, where we use domain KGs to retrieve physically consistent historical analogs for regional flood forecasts, improving geographic localisation over a latent-only baseline. Operating entirely without internal model access, our approach provides an efficient, interpretable mechanism for post-hoc influence analysis and domain-grounded retrieval.

AI.title_translation: FrED：通过领域知识图谱接地进行外部数据影响估计
AI.tldr: 提出一个黑盒概率框架FrED，通过融合特征相似性和领域知识图谱来估计外部数据影响，解决了生成AI训练数据归因的透明性和可解释性问题，并在艺术图像合成和天气预报中展现了高效和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速部署凸显了训练数据归因对透明度和问责制的关键需求。现有参数方法需要计算成本高昂的模型权重访问，而基于相似性的方法则忽略了深层结构上下文。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的概率框架，完全在黑盒设置下运行。该方法将连续特征相似性与离散的、领域特定的知识图谱（KGs）融合，确保归因植根于结构现实，明确奖励高度特定的历史样本，并防止通用背景数据主导结果。
AI.result: 在艺术图像合成领域，实现了强大的线性数据建模分数，超过了标准的黑盒相似性基线，并大大缩小了与基于梯度的估计器的差距。在环境预测的交叉领域案例研究中，使用领域知识图谱检索物理一致的历史模拟数据用于区域洪水预测，改善了地理定位，优于仅基于潜在空间的基线。
AI.conclusion: 在完全不需要内部模型访问的情况下，该方法提供了一种高效、可解释的机制，用于事后影响分析和领域接地检索。
AI.translation: 生成式AI的快速部署加剧了训练数据归因对确保透明度和问责制的关键需求。然而，当前参数化方法需要计算成本高昂的模型权重访问，而基于相似性的方法则忽略了深层结构上下文。我们提出了一种新颖的概率框架，该框架完全在黑盒设置下运行。我们的方法将连续特征相似性与离散的、领域特定的知识图谱（KGs）融合。这种方法确保归因植根于结构现实，明确奖励高度特定的历史样本，同时防止通用背景数据主导结果。我们在两个不同的领域评估了我们的框架，在这两个领域中，将输出与数据和领域上下文联系起来本身就很复杂：抽象艺术图像合成和高维物理天气预报。广泛的基准测试证明了我们方法的强大功效。在艺术领域，它实现了强大的线性数据建模分数，超过了标准的黑盒相似性基线，同时大大缩小了与基于梯度的估计器的差距。我们还提出了一个环境预测中的跨领域可行性案例研究，其中我们使用领域知识图谱来检索区域洪水预测的物理一致的历史模拟数据，改善了地理定位，优于仅基于潜在空间的基线。我们的方法在完全不需要内部模型访问的情况下运行，为事后影响分析和领域接地检索提供了一种高效、可解释的机制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FrED，一个在黑盒设置下运行的新型概率框架，用于解决生成式AI中训练数据归因的透明度和可解释性问题。FrED通过融合连续特征相似性与领域知识图谱，将归因结果与结构现实相结合，有效区分特定历史样本和通用背景数据。该方法在艺术图像合成和高维物理天气预报两个复杂领域进行了评估，结果表明其性能优于现有黑盒基线，并能显著缩小与梯度估计器的差距，同时在环境预测中改善了地理定位。FrED提供了一种无需内部模型访问的高效、可解释的事后影响分析和领域接地检索机制。
AI.keywords: 训练数据归因, 黑盒模型, 知识图谱, 生成式AI, 影响估计
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的黑盒数据归因方法，通过引入领域知识图谱（KGs）来弥补现有相似性方法在结构上下文方面的不足，这是一个重要的突破。在生成式AI日益普及的背景下，解决数据归因的透明性和问责制问题具有重要意义。该方法的优势在于其无需模型内部访问的特性，大大拓宽了其应用范围。在两个复杂领域的成功应用证明了其泛化能力和实用性。未来的挑战可能在于如何构建和维护高质量、全面的领域知识图谱，这可能是一个复杂且耗时的过程。

title: Lost in Context: Addressing Context Anxiety in Large Language Models
summary: Conventional wisdom suggests that reasoning models fail when problems exceed their capabilities. However, we find that frontier reasoning models sometimes possess the necessary capabilities to solve problems but fail due to premature self-doubt -- a phenomenon informally known as context anxiety. We provide the first systematic study of context anxiety, demonstrating that it arises, in part, from a model's inability to accurately estimate the tokens required to complete a task. We also show that context anxiety leads to material efficiency losses when models operate under perceived constraints. Building on this analysis, we further show that models can learn alternative strategies for solving long-horizon problems without exhibiting context anxiety, suggesting that performance improvements may be achievable not through scaling model capabilities, but by improving models' ability to accurately assess and adapt to their own limitations.

AI.title_translation: 迷失在语境中：解决大型语言模型中的语境焦虑
AI.tldr: 前沿推理模型有时具备解决问题的能力，但由于过早的自我怀疑（语境焦虑）而失败。研究发现语境焦虑部分源于模型无法准确估计完成任务所需的token，并提出模型可以通过学习替代策略来避免语境焦虑。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为推理模型失败是因为超出能力。然而，本文发现前沿推理模型有时具备解决问题的能力，但却因过早的自我怀疑（非正式地称为语境焦虑）而失败。本研究的动机是对这种语境焦虑现象进行首次系统性研究。
AI.method: 本研究首次对语境焦虑进行了系统性研究，通过分析证明语境焦虑部分源于模型无法准确估计完成任务所需的token。
AI.result: 研究发现语境焦虑导致模型在感知约束下运行时出现实质性的效率损失。同时，研究表明模型可以学习解决长程问题的替代策略，而不会表现出语境焦虑。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论，大型语言模型性能的提升可能不是通过扩展模型能力来实现，而是通过提高模型准确评估和适应自身局限性的能力来实现。
AI.translation: 传统观点认为，当问题超出其能力范围时，推理模型就会失败。然而，我们发现前沿推理模型有时具备解决问题所需的必要能力，但却因过早的自我怀疑而失败——这种现象非正式地称为语境焦虑。我们首次对语境焦虑进行了系统性研究，表明它部分源于模型无法准确估计完成任务所需的token。我们还表明，当模型在感知约束下运行时，语境焦虑会导致实质性的效率损失。在此分析的基础上，我们进一步表明模型可以学习解决长程问题的替代策略，而不会表现出语境焦虑，这表明性能的提高可能不是通过扩展模型能力来实现，而是通过提高模型准确评估和适应自身局限性的能力来实现。
AI.summary: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型中的“语境焦虑”现象，发现前沿推理模型有时具备解决问题的能力，但因无法准确估计完成任务所需的token而表现出过早的自我怀疑，导致效率损失。研究表明，模型可以通过学习替代策略来解决长程问题，避免语境焦虑，并提出模型性能的提升应侧重于提高其自我评估和适应能力，而非单纯扩展模型能力。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 语境焦虑, 推理能力, 效率损失, 自我评估
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一个新颖且重要的概念“语境焦虑”，挑战了关于模型失败的传统认知。它强调了模型自我认知和适应能力的重要性，为未来LLM的优化提供了新的方向，即关注模型如何更好地管理其内部状态和资源，而不仅仅是扩大规模或提高原始推理能力。

title: Do VLMs Read or Rewrite? On Transcription Faithfulness in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used in place of traditional OCR pipelines for document understanding. In this paper, we show they do not always act as faithful transcribers: when text is imperfect, they often tend to rewrite it into a more plausible form - a behavior that clean-text OCR benchmarks cannot detect. We introduce FaithC4, a multilingual perturbation benchmark of 1,455 single-page documents (English, Chinese, Korean) with three perturbation families: scramble, random substitution, and visually similar substitution. We use the benchmark to evaluate 15 systems spanning general-purpose VLMs, OCR-specialized VLMs, and traditional OCR pipelines. These three categories differ in WER degradation under perturbation: general-purpose VLMs degrade by up to 4.5 points, OCR-specialized VLMs by 0.2-2 points, and traditional OCR by less than 0.6 points on English. Probing Qwen3-VL-4B layer-by-layer, we identify a consistent pattern: rewriting fires only when a perturbed word's final layer FFN representation stays close to the original encoding; when the representation diverges sufficiently, the model transcribes faithfully. Word length affects rewriting rate: short words (4-6 characters) are rewritten up to 10% of the time, with a sharp cutoff at 8 characters above which rewriting drops to 0%.

AI.title_translation: 视觉语言模型是读还是写？关于视觉语言模型的转录忠实度
AI.tldr: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理有瑕疵的文本时，倾向于改写而非忠实转录，这在传统OCR基准测试中无法发现。研究引入了一个包含三种扰动类型（打乱、随机替换、视觉相似替换）的多语言扰动基准FaithC4，评估了15种系统，发现通用VLM在扰动下的词错误率（WER）下降最多，而OCR专用VLM和传统OCR系统下降较少。通过对Qwen3-VL-4B的层级分析，发现改写行为的触发与扰动词的最终层FFN表示是否接近原始编码有关，且短词（4-6个字符）比长词更容易被改写。
AI.motivation: 评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在文档理解任务中作为OCR替代品的转录忠实度，并揭示它们在处理不完美文本时存在的“改写”行为，这种行为传统OCR基准测试无法检测。
AI.method: 引入了一个名为FaithC4的多语言扰动基准，包含1455份单页文档，涵盖英语、中文、韩语，并设计了三种扰动类型：打乱、随机替换和视觉相似替换。使用该基准评估了15种系统（通用VLM、OCR专用VLM、传统OCR），并通过层级分析Qwen3-VL-4B来理解改写行为的机制，同时分析了词长对改写率的影响。
AI.result: 通用VLM在扰动下的词错误率（WER）下降最多（最高4.5个点），OCR专用VLM下降2-20个点，传统OCR系统下降少于0.6个点（以英语为例）。改写行为仅在扰动词的最终层FFN表示接近原始编码时触发，当表示发散时模型会忠实转录。4-6个字符的短词被改写的概率高达10%，而8个字符以上的词改写率则降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在处理不完美文本时，并非总是忠实转录，而是会倾向于改写成更合理的形式。这种改写行为的触发机制与模型的内部表示有关，并且受到词语长度的影响。FaithC4基准能够有效评估这种改写行为，揭示了不同类型系统在处理扰动文本时的差异。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）正越来越多地被用作文档理解的传统光学字符识别（OCR）流程的替代品。在本研究中，我们发现它们并不总是作为忠实的转录器：当文本不完美时，它们常常倾向于将其改写成更合理的形式——这种行为是干净文本OCR基准测试无法检测到的。我们引入了FaithC4，一个包含1455份单页文档（英语、中文、韩语）的多语言扰动基准，包含三种扰动类型：打乱、随机替换和视觉相似替换。我们使用该基准评估了涵盖通用VLM、OCR专用VLM和传统OCR流程的15个系统。这三类系统在英语扰动下的词错误率（WER）下降幅度不同：通用VLM下降高达4.5个点，OCR专用VLM下降0.2-2个点，传统OCR下降小于0.6个点。通过逐层探测Qwen3-VL-4B，我们发现了一个一致的模式：只有当扰动词的最终层FFN表示接近原始编码时，改写才会发生；当表示发散足够时，模型会忠实转录。词长影响改写率：短词（4-6个字符）被改写的概率高达10%，而在8个字符以上时，改写率急剧下降至0%。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了视觉语言模型（VLM）在文档理解任务中的转录忠实度问题。研究发现，VLM在面对不完美的文本时，倾向于进行“改写”而非精确转录，这一行为传统OCR基准测试无法捕捉。为此，研究者提出了一个名为FaithC4的多语言扰动基准，包含三种文本扰动类型，用于评估通用VLM、OCR专用VLM和传统OCR系统。实验结果表明，通用VLM在扰动下的性能下降最明显，而OCR专用VLM和传统OCR系统表现出更高的鲁棒性。通过对模型内部机制的分析，研究者发现改写行为的触发与模型对扰动词的内部表示有关，并且词语长度是影响改写率的一个重要因素。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 转录忠实度, 改写行为, 扰动基准, FaithC4
AI.comments: 该研究有效地揭示了视觉语言模型在处理不完美文本时存在的潜在问题，即“改写”而非精确转录。FaithC4基准的提出为量化评估这一行为提供了有力工具。层级分析揭示的改写触发机制具有重要的理论意义。然而，研究可以进一步探讨改写行为对下游任务的具体影响，以及如何通过模型设计或训练来缓解不期望的改写。

title: LeafData: An Agentic System for Data Migration
summary: Modern data migration relies on JSON configuration to define data connection, pipeline logic, and orchestration behavior. This requires domain knowledge from users and is time-consuming and error-prone. In this paper, we present LeafData, an agentic system that converts user intent into validated and executable JSON configuration for data migration. Specifically, LeafData comprises a frontend chatbot and the backend service. The chatbot incrementally collects required information from users and performs schema-driven validation, while the backend service processes validated inputs and generates JSON configuration artifacts. These artifacts are directly consumable by orchestration platforms, enabling end-to-end pipeline generation and execution without manual coding. LeafData supports heterogeneous data migration across various data sources and connectors including relational databases, file-based systems, document-oriented databases, and REST APIs.

AI.title_translation: 叶数据：一个用于数据迁移的代理系统
AI.tldr: LeafData是一个代理系统，它将用户意图转化为数据迁移的JSON配置，简化了数据迁移过程。
AI.motivation: 现代数据迁移依赖于JSON配置，这需要领域知识且耗时易错。
AI.method: LeafData包含一个前端聊天机器人，用于收集信息和进行模式驱动验证，以及一个后端服务，用于处理输入并生成JSON配置。
AI.result: LeafData能够生成直接可被编排平台使用的JSON配置，实现无需手动编码的端到端管道生成和执行，支持异构数据迁移。
AI.conclusion: LeafData通过将用户意图转化为自动生成的JSON配置，成功简化了数据迁移过程，提高了效率和准确性，并支持广泛的数据源。
AI.translation: 现代数据迁移依赖于JSON配置来定义数据连接、管道逻辑和编排行为。这需要用户具备领域知识，并且耗时且容易出错。在本文中，我们提出了LeafData，一个代理系统，它将用户意图转换为经过验证且可执行的JSON配置，用于数据迁移。具体来说，LeafData包括一个前端聊天机器人和后端服务。聊天机器人会逐步从用户那里收集所需信息，并执行模式驱动的验证，而后端服务则处理经过验证的输入并生成JSON配置工件。这些工件可以直接被编排平台使用，从而无需手动编码即可实现端到端的管道生成和执行。LeafData支持跨各种数据源和连接器的异构数据迁移，包括关系数据库、基于文件的系统、面向文档的数据库和REST API。
AI.summary: LeafData是一个创新的代理系统，它通过前端聊天机器人和后端服务，将用户的数据迁移意图转化为自动生成的JSON配置，从而简化了复杂且易出错的传统数据迁移流程，并支持异构数据源的迁移。
AI.keywords: 数据迁移,代理系统,JSON配置,聊天机器人,异构数据源
AI.comments: 该系统通过引入代理和聊天机器人的概念，大大降低了数据迁移的门槛，提高了效率和准确性。其模式驱动的验证和对异构数据源的支持是关键优势。

title: Adversarial Style Optimization: Enhancing VLM Jailbreaks by GRPO-based Stylistic Triggers Optimization
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved impressive performance, but their safety alignment remains vulnerable to jailbreak attacks. Existing content-based jailbreaks are often inconsistent and show unsatisfying performance against the rapidly evolving MLLMs, failing to exploit non-content-based vulnerabilities. Unlike previous research, we empirically find that MLLMs exhibit a Stylistic Inconsistency between their comprehension ability and safety ability: MLLMs can robustly understand content regardless of visual style, yet their defense mechanisms can be easily bypassed by specific stylistic triggers. Based on this finding, we propose Adversarial Style Optimization (ASO), a plug-and-play enhancement module to amplify existing visual jailbreaks. ASO fine-tunes an image-editing model to superimpose an optimized stylistic modification onto a given adversarial image, using a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) agent guided by a Structurally-Tiered Reward Function that combines a logit-based signal for detecting explicit refusals with a high-fidelity semantic evaluation from a powerful judge model. Extensive experiments show that ASO significantly enhances the ASR of SOTA attacks, demonstrating that stylistic biases are a scalable vector for red-teaming MLLMs. Our code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/ASO.

AI.title_translation: 对抗性风格优化：基于GRPO的风格化触发器优化，增强VLM越狱
AI.tldr: MLLMs虽然性能强大，但其安全对齐易受越狱攻击。本研究发现MLLMs在理解能力和安全能力之间存在风格不一致性，并提出了一种名为ASO的即插即用增强模块，通过GRPO和结构化奖励函数来优化风格化修改，以增强现有的视觉越狱攻击。实验表明ASO能显著提高攻击的ASR，证明风格偏差是红队测试MLLMs的可扩展向量。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于内容的越狱方法在面对快速发展的MLLMs时，往往表现出不一致且性能不佳，未能利用非内容漏洞。MLLMs在理解能力和安全能力之间存在风格不一致性：它们能鲁棒地理解内容，但其防御机制容易被特定的风格化触发器绕过。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ASO（Adversarial Style Optimization）的即插即用增强模块。ASO通过微调一个图像编辑模型，利用基于GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）的智能体，并结合一个结构化奖励函数（该函数结合了基于logit的信号和强大的裁判模型的语义评估），将优化的风格化修改叠加到给定的对抗性图像上。
AI.result: ASO显著增强了SOTA攻击的ASR（Attack Success Rate），证明了风格偏差是红队测试MLLMs的可扩展向量。
AI.conclusion: 风格偏差是红队测试MLLMs的可扩展向量。ASO作为一种即插即用模块，可以有效增强现有的视觉越狱攻击，揭示了MLLMs在安全对齐方面的新脆弱性。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）取得了令人瞩目的性能，但其安全对齐仍然容易受到越狱攻击。现有的基于内容的越狱方法往往不一致，并且在面对快速发展的MLLMs时表现不佳，未能利用非内容漏洞。与以往的研究不同，我们通过实证发现MLLMs在理解能力和安全能力之间表现出风格不一致性：MLLMs能够鲁棒地理解内容，而不管视觉风格如何，但它们的防御机制很容易被特定的风格化触发器绕过。基于这一发现，我们提出了对抗性风格优化（ASO），一个即插即用的增强模块，用于增强现有的视觉越狱。ASO通过一个基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的智能体来微调一个图像编辑模型，该智能体由一个结构化分层奖励函数指导，该函数结合了用于检测显式拒绝的基于logit的信号和一个强大的裁判模型的保真语义评估。大量实验表明，ASO显著增强了SOTA攻击的ASR，证明了风格偏差是红队测试MLLMs的可扩展向量。我们的代码可在https://github.com/bingjunluo/ASO获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了对抗性风格优化（ASO）方法，通过优化风格化触发器来增强多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的越狱攻击。研究发现MLLMs在理解和安全能力上存在风格不一致性，并利用此漏洞，通过GRPO智能体和结构化奖励函数对图像进行风格化修改，显著提升了越狱攻击的成功率，证明了风格偏差是攻击MLLMs的重要途径。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型, 越狱攻击, 对抗性风格优化, GRPO, 风格不一致性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个新颖的视角，即利用MLLMs的风格不一致性来增强越狱攻击，这为理解和防御MLLMs的安全漏洞提供了新的思路。ASO作为一种即插即用模块，具有实际应用价值。然而，该方法可能仅限于视觉内容，并且其在不同类型或更复杂的MLLMs上的泛化能力有待进一步验证。

title: From Profiles to Steering Vectors: Global Sparse Priors and Local Semantic Calibration for Personalized Text Generation
summary: Personalized text generation requires models to capture user-specific writing styles from historical data. Existing approaches based on retrieval, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, or activation steering either introduce inference and storage overhead or struggle to separate stylistic signals from semantic content. We propose GLASS, a training-free framework for personalized generation via Global-Local Activation Steering with Sparse priors. GLASS uses sparse autoencoders to extract a global user-style prior from historical responses and constructs local contrastive style vectors over clustered interaction scenarios. During inference, it jointly injects global and local vectors into different model layers, enabling context-aware personalization without retrieval or parameter updates. Experiments on LaMP and LongLaMP show that GLASS outperforms retrieval-, fine-tuning-, and steering-based baselines across ROUGE metrics and LLM-as-judge evaluations. Further analyses show that SAE-based representations are more robust to topic and length shifts, suggesting better disentanglement of stylistic information from semantic residue.

AI.title_translation: 从配置文件到引导向量：用于个性化文本生成的全局稀疏先验和局部语义校准
AI.tldr: GLASS是一个无需训练的框架，通过全局-局部激活引导和稀疏先验来实现个性化文本生成，它使用稀疏自编码器提取全局用户风格先验，并构建局部对比风格向量，在推理时将全局和局部向量注入不同模型层，以实现上下文感知个性化，无需检索或参数更新。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在个性化文本生成时，要么引入推理和存储开销，要么难以将风格信号与语义内容分开。
AI.method: GLASS框架使用稀疏自编码器提取全局用户风格先验，并构建局部对比风格向量，在推理时将全局和局部向量注入不同模型层。
AI.result: 实验表明，GLASS在ROUGE指标和LLM评估中优于现有的基线方法，并且基于SAE的表示对主题和长度变化更具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GLASS通过结合全局和局部风格信息，实现了有效的上下文感知个性化文本生成，并且比现有方法更具鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 个性化文本生成需要模型从历史数据中捕捉用户特定的写作风格。现有的基于检索、参数高效微调或激活引导的方法，要么引入推理和存储开销，要么难以将风格信号与语义内容分开。我们提出了GLASS，一个通过全局-局部激活引导和稀疏先验实现个性化生成的免训练框架。GLASS使用稀疏自编码器从历史响应中提取全局用户风格先验，并构建跨越聚类交互场景的局部对比风格向量。在推理过程中，它将全局和局部向量联合注入不同的模型层，从而在无需检索或参数更新的情况下实现上下文感知的个性化。在LaMP和LongLaMP上的实验表明，GLASS在ROUGE指标和LLM作为裁判的评估中，在基于检索、微调和引导的方法上均表现出色。进一步的分析表明，基于SAE的表示对主题和长度的变化更具鲁棒性，表明风格信息与语义残留物能够更好地分离。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了GLASS框架，一个无需训练的个性化文本生成方法。该方法利用稀疏自编码器提取全局用户风格先验，并结合局部对比风格向量，通过将这些向量注入模型的不同层来实现上下文感知的个性化，避免了传统方法的开销。实验证明GLASS在多个指标上优于现有方法，并表现出更好的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 个性化文本生成, 全局-局部引导, 稀疏自编码器, 风格迁移, 上下文感知
AI.comments: 该方法通过结合全局和局部信息，在不更新模型参数的情况下实现了有效的个性化，具有创新性。然而，其对稀疏自编码器和交互场景聚类的依赖性可能需要进一步研究。

title: Local Synaptic Rules Can Implement a SIGReg Gradient Without Backpropagation
comments: 10 pages, 1 figure. Associated code at https://github.com/mdda/biological-sigreg
summary: We prove that two canonical local synaptic learning rules, the potentiation arm of spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP$^+$) and homeostatic plasticity (instantiated here via flashlight granule-cell-like neurons), together can implement the exact gradient of a SIGReg-like self-supervised learning objective. The equivalence requires no gradient calculations, no global error signals, no weight transport, and no label information: the only inputs are pre- and post-synaptic firing rates, local firing statistics, and the temporal contiguity of natural sensory streams. On a synthetic clustering task designed to probe whether class structure can be recovered from temporal ordering of inputs alone, ordered presentation raised cluster separation (CSR) to 2.49 while random ordering left it near baseline (0.83), a roughly threefold ($\approx 3.5σ$) separation attributable solely to input ordering. On temporally ordered MNIST, a two-layer network trained entirely with these rules achieved 87.3% linear-probe accuracy, showing that the mechanism functions end-to-end.

title: Cloud-Native Evaluation-as-a-Service: A Microservices Architecture for Scalable AI Monitoring with Conformal Guarantees
summary: We present EaaS, a cloud-native reference architecture that operationalizes AI evaluation methods as six stateless Kubernetes microservices: conformal prediction with finite-sample-corrected Adaptive Prediction Sets, calibration assessment, drift detection via RFF-approximated Maximum Mean Discrepancy, fairness monitoring with bootstrap confidence intervals, a DAG-based pipeline orchestrator, and a result storage API. We validate four key methodological concerns. First, empirical coverage is consistent with the marginal conformal guarantee across K=50 random calibration/test splits, with mean coverage within 1.4 percentage points of the nominal target. Second, all four MMLU answer tokens appear in the top-20 logprobs with 0% imputation needed, and simulated imputation at 10% produces less than 1.5% coverage impact. Third, RFF-MMD achieves 100% detection power for mild and severe drift at the median heuristic bandwidth, with Type I error between 5-8.5%. Fourth, fairness monitoring on the UCI Adult Income dataset reveals significant demographic parity disparities by race (DP gap=0.33) with stable alerts across sequential batches. Conformal prediction and calibration services achieve sub-2ms p99 latency at batch size 100; RFF-MMD requires ~500ms suited for periodic batch monitoring. A comparison with four open-source tools suggests that, to the best of our knowledge, no current platform combines conformal-prediction-as-a-service, microservice decomposition, and DAG-based orchestration.

title: FBLayout: Optimizing Memory Layout for Efficient LLM Finetuning on Mobile GPUs
summary:
Transformer-based models have enabled unprecedented capabilities across language, vision, and multimodal tasks. On-device fine-tuning of transformer models offers a privacy-preserving path to personalized AI, yet remains inefficient on mobile GPUs due to severe memory constraints and frequent layout transformations in attention mechanism during training. Existing mobile training frameworks either use unified layouts for forward and backward passes -- leading to fragmented memory access and poor GPU utilization during backpropagation -- or rely on explicit layout conversions, which introduce significant transformation overhead.
  To overcome this, we propose FBLayout, a layout-aware framework that co-designs tensor organization with mobile GPU platforms. FBLayout introduces: (1) a unified R-Tile layout for multi-dimensional reductions across forward/backward passes; (2) tile-based index transformation to eliminate physical data movement; and (3) activation-guided layout selection to propagate efficient layouts globally. Evaluations on seven transformer models across different mobile phones (including ARM Mali and Qualcomm Adreno GPUs) show that FBLayout achieves 2.2-5.7x speedup over MNN, TFLite, and TVM, while significantly improving cache efficiency and reducing memory footprint, enabling practical on-device large model fine-tuning.

title: Trajectory-Aware Retrieval Agents for Temporal Decision- Making
summary: We study the problem of decision-making from long-form, temporally structured text using large language model (LLM) agents. Standard retrievalaugmented generation (RAG) pipelines fragment chronological context into isolated snippets, discarding the temporal structure that is often critical for correct downstream decisions. We introduce TLM (Trajectory Language Model), a closed-loop agentic framework that iteratively refines the evidence set using SHAP-guided feedback. The key technical contribution is the latent growth curve model (LGCM) over retrieved chunk embeddings, which provides an interpretable mechanism for detecting trajectory trends, turning points, and information gaps. We show that, under a scorer-calibration assumption (which holds approximately in practice), the iterative refinement procedure is monotonically non-decreasing in the probability assigned to the correct label. Empirically, TLM is evaluated on three temporally grounded decision tasks: medical question answering, earnings call surprise prediction, and overnight stock gap prediction. TLM substantially outperforms both zero-shot LLM baselines and standard retrieval-augmented approaches on the medical task, and yields consistent, economically meaningful gains on the two financial tasks.

title: Discrete Action Space as a Prerequisite for GRPO Convergence in Small-Model Continuous Control
summary: We study whether Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) can fine-tune small language models for simulated quadrotor continuous-control tasks. In our benchmark, vanilla GRPO fine-tuning of Qwen-0.5B for 25 Hz quadrotor velocity control collapses to the trivial zero action: 0 percent success rate, with entropy falling from 0.35 to 0.03 within 60 steps. Two ablations - removing the jerk-penalty term and removing the KL anchor to the pretrained prior - each prevent entropy collapse, yet neither enables learning. When the action interface is replaced by a 5-way categorical choice over PID presets, training converges. The resulting controller traces a smoothness-reliability Pareto frontier along training duration; both endpoints are reported: 98.6 percent success with 0.656 m/s3 jerk at 64 steps, and 100 percent success with 1.103 m/s3 jerk, or 0.796 under a matched velocity cap, at 256 steps. The recipe is evaluated across three pretrained language models. As context, a re-tuned classical baseline, PID with Ki = 0.30 and vmax = 2.5, reaches the same 100 percent success rate at jerk 0.736 m/s3. A high-fidelity simulation using Crazyflie 2.1 dynamics surfaces a hover-region training-distribution gap.

title: Do Modules Stay in Their Lane? Role Drift in Compound LLM Systems
summary: End-to-end reinforcement learning can improve the accuracy of compound LLM systems, but it does not constrain how modules divide labor internally. We identify Role Drift, a failure mode in which modules preserve or improve end-task performance while deviating from their assigned roles through role-violating shortcuts that remain invisible to system-level evaluation. To make role drift observable and controllable, we propose Role Anchor, a regularizer that modulates how much each module deviates from its assigned role during end-to-end training. The key idea is to preserve how the role prompt shifts the module's next-token predictions relative to a neutral prompt, which serves as a proxy for the role's intended effect during training. Experiments on two compound LLM pipelines reveal role drift that accuracy alone fails to detect: a decomposer meant to split a question into sub-questions for a separate solver instead plants the answer in them, and a reader meant to answer from retrieved passages instead falls back on parametric memory. In fact, on the decomposer pipeline this shortcut drives most of the apparent RL gain: 86% of it vanishes once the decomposer is held to its role, indicating that terminal accuracy alone can badly overstate how much a compound system has genuinely learned. Across both pipelines, Role Anchor mitigates role drift at a tunable accuracy cost that varies by pipeline and anchor strength. Additional gradient analysis suggests that the regularizer reduces alignment with the role-drift direction rather than simply suppressing learning.

title: Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation
summary: Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, ours outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, ours approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

title: Evolving Self-Organising Agents Without Fitness: Three Falsifiable Experiments from Constraint-Driven Selection to Developmental Encoding
comments: GECCO Companion '26 Workshop Paper (EvoSelf/ESO Workshop), July 13-17, 2026, San Jose, Costa Rica. 3 pages. ACM ISBN 979-8-4007-2488-6/2026/07
summary: Can evolutionary dynamics characteristic of biological development arise without a designer-specified fitness function? We present Genesis, a platform in which agents inhabit a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion substrate and evolve under physical constraints alone. Three successive experimental cycles, each testing one falsifiable hypothesis, show: (1) constraint-driven selection sustains evolutionary activity after complete fitness removal but reaches a hard phenotypic complexity ceiling; (2) agent-mediated niche construction via chemical secretion is real but causally insufficient to break that ceiling; and (3) replacing the fixed-alphabet genome with a Compositional Pattern Producing Network (CPPN) indirect encoding, protected by NEAT-style speciation, produces the first evidence of progressive structural complexification in a fitness-free system. Null results are treated as precise, informative answers rather than failures, yielding reusable diagnostic tools and a sham-control protocol applicable to any open-ended evolution evaluation pipeline.

title: Genesis: An Empirical Platform for Studying Open-Ended Evolution Without Fitness Functions
comments: Accepted as a Late-Breaking Abstract at the Genetic and Evolutionary Computation Conference Companion (GECCO Companion '26), July 13-17, 2026, San Jose, Costa Rica
summary: Biological evolution sustains complex dynamics without any fitness function, yet virtually all evolutionary algorithms depend on one. Genesis is an open-source platform designed to test, empirically, what an artificial system needs to sustain evolutionary dynamics after complete fitness removal. Evolution in Genesis is governed by physical constraints, relational dominance, and adaptive regulation - no scalar fitness, no designer-specified objectives. Across experiments totalling over one million evolutionary generations, Genesis has: (i) shown that constraint-driven selection can sustain evolutionary activity after complete fitness removal (7/12 runs; Wilson 95% CI [30.2%, 82.5%]; p<0.01, Cohen's d=1.47 vs. baselines); (ii) produced a sham-controlled negative result demonstrating that niche construction alone does not break the complexity plateau; and (iii) provided preliminary evidence that speciation-protected niche construction initiates structural diversification that unprotected secretion cannot. These findings establish empirical boundaries for fitness-free evolution and open a new direction: meta-evolution of physics, in which the laws governing an evolutionary system are themselves evolved.
